# Exploring Nature

> > Educational resource for K-12 nature science, covering ecosystems, wildlife identification, hands-on activities, and space exploration including NASA's Apollo missions.

Exploring Nature provides comprehensive educational materials for teachers and students, featuring field guides for tree and plant identification, ecosystem food webs, biology lessons, printable worksheets, and nature-based craft activities. The site also includes space science content documenting NASA's Apollo program and profiles of notable scientists.

## Key Topics

- nature education
- ecosystem food webs
- tree identification
- leaf identification
- deciduous trees
- biomes and habitats
- educational activities
- printable resources
- NASA Apollo missions
- wildlife biology
- nature crafts
- outdoor education
- coloring pages
- educational worksheets
- conservation

## Ecosystems and Food Webs

- [Introduction to Biomes and Habitats](https://exploringnature.org/introduction-to-biomes-and-habitats): Biology education guide to ecosystems, biomes, and community ecology basics
- [American Prairie Food Web](https://exploringnature.org/american-prairie-food-web): Prairie ecosystem food chain showing producers, consumers, and decomposers

## Tree and Plant Identification

- [Deciduous Tree Identification by the Leaves](https://exploringnature.org/deciduous-tree-identification-by-the-leaves): Guide to identifying deciduous trees using leaf shapes and vein patterns
- [Pine (Red)](https://exploringnature.org/pine-red): Red Pine (Pinus resinosa) identification guide with botanical diagrams

## Biology and Life Sciences

- [Genetic Engineering](https://exploringnature.org/genetic-engineering): Educational resource on recombinant DNA technology and insulin cloning
- [Arthropods (Insects, Spiders, Crustaceans, Centipedes, Millipedes)](https://exploringnature.org/arthropods-insects-spiders-crustaceans-centipedes-millipedes): Educational reference on arthropod invertebrates from insects to crustaceans
- [Epithelium - Epithelial Tissue](https://exploringnature.org/epithelium-epithelial-tissue): Human biology reference on epithelial tissue types and histology

## Educational Activities and Lessons

- [Seed Dispersal Adaptation - Authentic Performance](https://exploringnature.org/seed-dispersal-adaptation-authentic-performance): UbD-based biomimicry assessment activity on plant seed dispersal adaptations
- [Zoo Activity - Before You Go to The Zoo Animal Research](https://exploringnature.org/zoo-activity-before-you-go-to-the-zoo-animal-research): Pre-zoo visit worksheet for researching animal habitats and food webs
- [Choosing a Route for Content](https://exploringnature.org/choosing-a-route-for-content): Guide to planning educational nature trails with interpretive signage

## Nature Crafts and Projects

- [Make Your Own Nature Frame](https://exploringnature.org/make-your-own-nature-frame): Kids craft project tutorial for creating nature frames with natural materials
- [Plant Your Name - Growing Activity](https://exploringnature.org/plant-your-name-growing-activity): Hands-on beginner gardening activity for kids to grow plants spelling names
- [Draw Your Own Portable Animal Habitat Mural (or Tablecloth)](https://exploringnature.org/draw-your-own-portable-animal-habitat-mural-or-tablecloth): Art project instructions for creating habitat murals from coral reef to forest

## Space Science and Apollo Program

- [Apollo Missions - 1961 to 1974](https://exploringnature.org/apollo-missions-1961-to-1974): NASA Apollo program history from Kennedy's vision to lunar missions
- [Swan Leavitt (Henrietta)](https://exploringnature.org/swan-leavitt-henrietta): Biography of astronomer Henrietta Leavitt and her star distance work at Harvard

## Conservation and Wildlife

- [Endangered Species Success Story – The Peregrine Falcon](https://exploringnature.org/endangered-species-success-story-ndash-the-peregrine-falcon): Peregrine Falcon conservation success story and DDT pesticide recovery

## Optional Resources

- [Comfrey (Wild) Coloring Page](https://exploringnature.org/comfrey-wild-coloring-page): Printable wild comfrey plant coloring page for nature education
- [Mixed Forest Coloring Page](https://exploringnature.org/mixed-forest-coloring-page): Printable mixed forest ecosystem coloring page educational resource
- [Indian Cucumber Coloring Page](https://exploringnature.org/indian-cucumber-coloring-page): Printable Indian Cucumber plant coloring worksheet for nature education
- [Rainforest (African) Coloring Page](https://exploringnature.org/rainforest-african-coloring-page): Printable African rainforest coloring page educational material
